definitions.explanation: An official recommendation issued by local authorities urging residents to evacuate an area due to danger from natural disasters such as typhoons, floods, or landslides.

examples.japanese: {避難勧告|ひなんかんこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{避難勧告|ひなんかんこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An evacuation advisory was issued due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {避難勧告|ひなんかんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{避難所|ひなんじょ}→避難所：07374_hinanjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移動|いどう}した→移動する：22430_idousuru⟧。
examples.english: Residents moved to evacuation shelters after receiving the evacuation advisory.

notes:
USAGE:
As of May 2021, Japan's disaster response system was revised. The previous three-level system ({避難準備|ひなんじゅんび}, {避難勧告|ひなんかんこく}, ⟦{避難指示|ひなんしじ}→避難指示：20801_hinanshiji⟧) was simplified, with {避難勧告|ひなんかんこく} being abolished and merged into ⟦{避難指示|ひなんしじ}→避難指示：20801_hinanshiji⟧. However, the term remains widely known and may still appear in older materials and historical reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {避難勧告|ひなんかんこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (an advisory is issued)
- {避難勧告|ひなんかんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to issue an advisory)
- {避難勧告|ひなんかんこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}される→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧ (an advisory is lifted)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{避難指示|ひなんしじ}→避難指示：20801_hinanshiji⟧: evacuation order (stronger than advisory)
- ⟦{避難所|ひなんじょ}→避難所：07374_hinanjo⟧: evacuation shelter
